messages:
maria_cs: FYI - Ellipsia Health onboarding: their summary pipeline is burning tokens and long-context interactions have a fat tail. p95 ~410ms, p99 ~1.1s, avg tokens ~900. Renewal signal weak unless latency improves.

lucas_ml: Quick win ideas: int8 quant profile on compact model, route >1k token requests to compact variant, enable prefix/KV cache for repeated docs. Small canary first.

raj_sre: Can do a 5% canary pool and routing rule. Need the acceptance criteria and rollback plan.

maria_cs: Acceptance: p95 <300ms AND summary quality regression <=1.0% (ROUGE/L). Rollback immediate if quality or error rate spikes.

lucas_ml: Canary plan draft:

```yaml
canary_name: ellipsia-compact-int8-canary
steps:
  - pct: 5
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_profile_C
    cache_prefix: true
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
  - wait: 3h
  - pct: 25
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_profile_C
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - summary_quality_delta: "<=1.0%"
```

Also propose routing rule: send token_length > 1000 to canary during window.

emma_success: Schedule a short enablement call and capture example prompts that matter. We need client buy-in on quality tradeoff.

maria_cs: Client contact is ellie@ellipsia.health, available Tue 11am PT. Ill invite. Also can we prepare a one-pager: expected latency, cost delta, rollback steps, sample diff?

lucas_ml: I'll draft the one-pager and attach by EOD.

raj_sre: Applying routing config now and provisioning a 5% canary pool. Rule I apply:

{"route_policy":"token_length","threshold":1000,"destination":"ellipsia-compact-int8-canary","fallback":"llm-standard"}

ops-bot: Canary "ellipsia-compact-int8-canary" created by raj_sre. Start epoch: 4681240000. Monitoring hooks enabled, alert if error_rate > 1% or quality_delta > 1.0%. :rocket:

emma_success: On the call we'll collect subjective feedback (perceived latency, any hallucination concerns) and add failing examples to eval set.

maria_cs: Plan: 1) enablement call Tue 11am PT, 2) lucas finalizes playbook + quality thresholds, 3) raj launches 5% canary (done), 4) monitor 72h, add client examples to evals, 5) scale to 25% only if p95 <300ms and quality_delta <=1%. Will report back here after call. :thumbsup:
